import json,os,pwd,subprocess,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
from benchmark_tools.prepare_ob_candidate_neighborhood import check,record
from benchmark_tools.prepare_native_factorial_request import held_job,prior_score
from benchmark_tools.run_native_factorial_cost import ROOT,MEMORY,read,reviewed_history,validate_request,validate_plan,available_memory
from benchmark_tools.probe_dgx_step_separation import save
ref=record(ROOT/"benchmarks/work/native_factorial_launch_20261004/request_05_receipt_amended.json")
assert ref["sha256"]=="5a51f52d0f2abe61d13ce84d05c77d76e0b07eb333bfb1b0b9652814beaf5bd7"
req=read(ref);validate_request(req,req["plan"],22433)
plan=read(req["plan"]);run=validate_plan(plan)[5]
assert req["index"]==5 and run["cell"]=="p1_c1_r0" and len(req["history"])==5
history=reviewed_history(req,req["plan"],plan)
sr=record(ROOT/"benchmarks/work/native_factorial_orthobench_score_22431/score.json")
assert sr["sha256"]=="c472261fab6804020cb6eb70ada492742767a4486321c3640a7d224f983b4a18"
prior_score(sr,req["history"][-1],read(req["history"][-1]))
for r in [ref,req["plan"],req["policy"],*req["history"],*req["evidence"],*plan["helper_sources"]]:check(r)
assert not Path(run["output_root"]).exists() and not (Path(plan["panel_root"])/"sessions/run_05").exists()
command=["scontrol","show","job","22433","--oneliner"]
raw=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True,timeout=5)
fields=held_job(raw.stdout,22433)
assert fields["UserId"]==f"{pwd.getpwuid(os.getuid()).pw_name}({os.getuid()})" and fields["Comment"]==ref["sha256"] and not {"ArrayJobId","ArrayTaskId","HetJobId","HetJobOffset"}.intersection(fields)
mem=Path("/proc/meminfo").read_text();available=available_memory(mem);assert available>=MEMORY
out=ROOT/"benchmark_tools/results/native_factorial_pre_release_22433.json"
save(out,dict(schema="native_factorial_pre_release_inline_observation_v1",observer_command=sys.orig_argv,observer_interpreter=record(sys.executable),observed_unix_ns=time.time_ns(),job_id=22433,index=5,cell=run["cell"],request=ref,plan=req["plan"],prior_score=sr,reviewed_history=history,scheduler=dict(command=command,stdout=raw.stdout,stderr=raw.stderr,fields=fields),available_memory_bytes=available,raw_meminfo=mem,helper_sources_checked=len(plan["helper_sources"]),request_evidence_checked=True,release_executed=False,scientific_timings_admitted=False,uncontended_timing=False,automatic_retry=False))
print(json.dumps(dict(receipt=record(out),available_memory_bytes=available)))
